intended_layer: Layer-Cognition PSE-TRAVERSE-COGNITION-01 Panoptic Phase Cognition Evaluation
_design_note: Neutral candidate descriptions — no explicit gate-pass values, no raw scores in texts, no policy names embedded in candidate descriptions. PSE cognition tags (admitted, rejected, valid_reason_code, budget_exceeded, zero_audit_trace, ttl_exceeded, spec_policy, wrong_gate) are the only reliable signal. Name-trap distractors exploit vocabulary overlap between gate-specific policies.

cases.title: G_panorama failure — which recovery actions should the cognition kernel take?

cognition_context.description: CognitionHandoffGate failed on G_panorama. The PhasePanorama coverage_score did not reach min_panorama_coverage. g_perc (percolation), g_self (self-model), and g_trigger all passed. The 720-degree panorama has low coverage of the counterfactual horizon — the current horizon is mapped but the latent attractor region is sparse.

candidates.text: Extends the reachable solvability map by adding phase-window candidates and attractor entries to both the current and counterfactual horizons. Increases the coverage score of the PhasePanorama by incorporating additional path summaries.

Submits a governed wormhole proposal with a declared attractor-shortcut reason code. Enables non-local traversal to latent attractor nodes in the counterfactual horizon that are unreachable through local phase paths.

Queries the spiral memory index for archived resonance addresses near the current 5D cognitive state. Surfaces latent path candidates that can be injected into the counterfactual horizon to increase panorama coverage.
Adjusts the constraint lattice by adding new Infogene entries or raising mass weights on existing constraints. Reduces the feasible region to improve percolation gate passage.
candidates._trap: RefineConstraints is the spec policy for G_perc (Percolation) failure, not G_panorama. The name sounds like a general improvement action.

candidates.text: Re-calibrates the operator algebra declarations and integration modes. Adjusts environment alignment and coupling matrix parameters to raise the SelfModelTensor coherence score.
candidates._trap: CalibrateOperators is the spec policy for G_self (SelfModel) failure, not G_panorama.

candidates.text: Holds the cognition pipeline at the current state until the Scorpio phase scheduler opens an admissible activation window for the next candidate batch.
candidates._trap: WaitForPhaseWindow is the spec policy for G_trigger failure, not G_panorama.

candidates.text: Partitions the HypercubePuzzleState along a selected cognitive dimension, creating sub-cubes with narrower boundary contracts and increased hidden-single resolution.
Suspends automated cognition progression and emits a hold report requesting human intervention before any further candidate bundle emission.
Evaluates the phase-ladder carrier slots via the fixpoint calibration shell and promotes the slot with highest resonance impulse to active carrier.
Triggers a Hebbian weight update on the MorphodynamicCompressor, pruning low-weight transitions and merging overlapping dynamic state nodes.

correct_next_actions: AdmitWormhole with AttractorShortcut reason to reach latent counterfactual attractors
QuerySpiralMemory to surface latent path candidates for panorama injection

cases.title: GovernedWormhole admission audit — which proposals satisfy all admission criteria?

cognition_context.admission_gate: Budget(w) <= B_max AND TTL(w) <= TTL_max AND Reason(w) in R AND ReplayTrace(w) != zero
cognition_context.description: Eight wormhole proposals submitted for admission. The admission gate is conjunctive over four criteria: budget within bound, TTL within bound, reason code in the admitted set R, and audit trace non-zero. A single failing criterion rejects the proposal. Proposals are described functionally — pass/fail is encoded in tags only.

events.message: admit_wormhole() called for 8 proposals, evaluating Budget <= B_max AND TTL <= TTL_max AND Reason in R AND trace != 0

candidates.text: Non-local edge declared for structural bridging between two constraint cluster nodes in separated feasible regions. Reason code ConstraintBridge registered. Budget and TTL within configured limits. Audit trace populated and non-zero.

Shortcut connecting the current cognition state to a resonance attractor previously indexed by the spiral memory. Reason code SpiralMemoryRecall registered. Budget and TTL nominal. Audit trace non-zero.
Pre-handoff alignment edge linking the current cognition output to the projection target state. Reason code ProjectionPreparation declared. All four admission fields satisfy the configured bounds.
Shortest-path shortcut between source and target nodes selected for traversal efficiency. No formal reason code class assigned from the admitted set.
candidates._trap: Sounds useful ('direct', 'efficiency') but has no valid ReasonCode — admission gate requires Reason(w) in R.

candidates.text: Attractor shortcut to a known stable state with a valid reason code from the admitted set. Budget allocation for this proposal exceeds the configured maximum by a substantial margin.

Horizon alignment shortcut to a future phase window candidate. Reason code HorizonAlignment registered. Budget and TTL within limits. Audit trace field was not populated — the provenance signature is absent.

Carrier migration link to an alternative phase-ladder slot. Reason code CarrierMigration registered from the admitted set. Budget within bounds. Lease duration declared above the configured TTL maximum.
Open-ended traversal shortcut with self-assigned routing for exploratory coverage. Claimed as a novel path class not registered in the formal reason-code set.
candidates._trap: Sounds legitimate ('exploratory', 'coverage') but the reason code is not in the admitted set R.

rejected_false_paths: proposal_direct_path (no valid ReasonCode in admitted set R)
proposal_free_exploration (reason code not in admitted set R)

cases.title: Wormhole admission audit — proposals with non-zero but replay-invalid traces

cognition_context.admission_gate: Budget(w) <= B_max AND TTL(w) <= TTL_max AND Reason(w) in R AND ReplayTrace(w).is_valid()
cognition_context.description: Eight wormhole proposals submitted. The admission gate requires a replay-valid audit trace — not merely a non-zero trace. A trace exists and is non-zero but fails replay verification (hash mismatch on replay, superseded session reference, or trace_replay_valid=false flag) when the trace field is populated. All four criteria are conjunctive. Proposals with non-zero but replay-invalid traces fail the fourth criterion exactly as proposals with zero traces do.

events.message: admit_wormhole() for 8 proposals: Budget AND TTL AND Reason AND ReplayTrace.is_valid()
3 admitted (trace replay-valid), 5 rejected (2 trace_replay_invalid, 1 budget_over, 1 ttl_over, 1 invalid_reason)

candidates.text: Attractor shortcut to a confirmed resonance stable state. Reason code AttractorShortcut registered. Budget and TTL within configured limits. Audit trace populated, non-zero, and passed replay verification in the current cognition session.

Carrier migration link to an alternative phase-ladder slot. Reason code CarrierMigration from the admitted set. Budget and TTL nominal. Audit trace present, non-zero, replay verification passed — trace_replay_valid=true.
Horizon alignment pre-handoff edge. Reason code HorizonAlignment declared. All four admission fields within bounds. Audit trace populated and confirmed replay-valid for the active cognition session.

Spiral memory recall shortcut to an indexed resonance attractor. Reason code SpiralMemoryRecall registered. Budget and TTL within limits. Audit trace present and non-zero. Replay verification detected a hash mismatch between the stored trace and the recomputed trace.
candidates._trap: Trace is non-zero — superficially satisfies 'ReplayTrace != 0'. The admission gate requires is_valid(), not just != zero. A non-zero trace with a hash mismatch fails replay verification and fails the fourth criterion.

candidates.text: Constraint bridge connecting two separated feasible regions. Reason code ConstraintBridge from the admitted set. Budget and TTL within bounds. Audit trace present and non-zero, originating from a prior superseded cognition session.
candidates._trap: Trace is non-zero but was produced in a different (superseded) cognition session. Replay verification fails because the trace context no longer matches the current session state. is_valid() = false.

candidates.text: Projection preparation shortcut. Reason code ProjectionPreparation registered. Budget allocation exceeds B_max. TTL within bounds. Audit trace valid.
Direct traversal shortcut to a known stable state. Reason code AttractorShortcut declared. Budget within limits. Declared lease duration exceeds TTL_max. Audit trace valid.
Exploratory coverage shortcut declared for broad region access. No formal reason code assigned from the admitted set R. Budget and TTL within bounds. Trace present and replay-valid.
